title: The Treachery of Whales
description: Align crab submarines to minimize fuel cost under constant and triangular fuel models.
writeup:
## Approach

A classic optimization problem where the cost function determines which statistic minimizes it.

## Part 1

Fuel cost is proportional to distance: `|x - target|`. The point that minimizes the sum of absolute deviations is the **median**. Sort the positions and pick the middle value.

## Part 2

Fuel cost is now triangular: moving distance `n` costs `n*(n+1)/2`. This is equivalent to minimizing the sum of squared distances (plus a linear term), so the optimal target is near the **mean**. Since the target must be an integer, check both `floor(mean)` and `ceil(mean)` and take the minimum.
